verdict.rationale: Eqvista's support docs include articles on downloading Extended and Summary cap table reports, so it has its own cap table export capability. The evidence never says whether these downloads are Excel/CSV or another format, and the only stated download format (round modeling) is PDF. Spreadsheet import is an inbound feature and does not count toward export. Missing for 10: confirmed Excel/CSV export format, export of full transaction history/timeline, any-time/plan-independent export guarantee, independent or hands-on corroboration.
